$comment: T10 R8 performance baseline. Measured by www/e2e/performance-budget.spec.ts (mobile 4G: 4 Mbps/3 Mbps/150 ms RTT, CPU 4x throttle, 390x844 DPR2, cold cache per run, median of N) on the alpha.15 candidate build in lane/t10-audit. Every field is a real measurement: INP is the worst event-timing duration across the scripted interactions (open search, type, escape, theme toggle, Tab), so a run with no interaction would report 0 and the comparison skips zero baselines.
note: Re-baselined from the harness's own first run (2026-10-18, 5 routes x 3 runs, --workers=1). The phase-1 audit numbers it replaced were measured without interactions (INP unmeasured, long-task totals correspondingly lower) and with content-length accounting, so they were not comparable: transferBytes now comes from CDP Network.loadingFinished.encodedDataLength and includes the scripted search round, and the home page's dragon media loads progressively — a run can capture only part of it, which is why / reads ~6.4 MB here against ~10.7 MB when the same page was observed with header accounting for longer.
